title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and compos

translated_title: StudioBench：面向生产力视听创作的智能体多模态大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 视频生成器如今已能渲染出令人信服的短片，然而完整的视听作品需要在多个阶段协调画面、声音与剪辑。现有基准测试仅关注单个生成器或在较窄制作环境下的视频智能体，而通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的端到端创作仍未得到充分探索。我们提出StudioBench，这是一个包含160个任务的基准测试，涵盖八种视频类型和五种任务类型，涉及多样的视听制作需求。模型需使用33个原子化的生成、编辑和检查工具，产出长达数分钟的成品视听内容，且无法访问shell或使用工作流模板。我们评估所交付的影片，并通过分析重构的工作流图来刻画生产行为并诊断失败原因。在对七种多模态大语言模型的评估中，显性要求的达成度已接近饱和，但在画面清晰度和构图等方面的制作质量差异显著。
tldr: 该论文提出StudioBench基准，通过160个跨八种视频类型的任务与33个原子化工具，首次系统评测通用多模态大语言模型进行端到端视听创作的能力，发现模型虽能基本满足显性要求，但实际制作质量差异显著。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StudioBench, a benchmark of 160 tasks across eight video genres using 33 atomic tools, which for the first time systematically evaluates general multimodal large language models on end-to-end audiovisual creation, revealing that while explicit requirements are nearly saturated, production quality varies substantially across models.
